overlays.scope: Actual factory panel photograph; depth/perspective residuals documented rather than warped away.

corrections: Dedicated G58 shell, radar nose, independent engine nacelles and 77-inch three-blade McCauley geometry replace the generic twin.

Calibrated top/side/front overlays led to a 0.35 m aft wing correction, 0.30 m forward tailplane correction, shorter nacelle afterbodies, rounded nose and closed trailing-edge bays between split flaps.
Factory panel photo calibrates actual two-display layout, right standby stack, dual yokes, six engine levers, subpanels and club cabin. Panel/yoke/pedestal gaps corrected after inspection.
Adaptable G1000 helper now offers mirrored twin RPM needles and two numeric readings connected independently to engine-1 and engine-2; zero, asymmetric cruise and missing sensors tested.
Explicit nearest-knot digital airspeed avoids floating-point truncation at nominal whole-knot values. Skyhawk, Skylane and Bonanza received the same metadata-only correction.
reviewNotes.visual: Individually inspected four turntables, ground three-quarter, pilot, cabin, wide cabin and calibrated side/top/front/panel overlays. Inspected zero, asymmetric 2500/1800-RPM cruise, upper-range and unavailable-speed/RPM/gear cases. Compared factory cockpit photo and McCauley/Garmin documentation, as well as CC BY-SA exterior photo. Verified current whole-knot readouts at cruise and upper range.
limitations: Manufacturer three-view consists of perspective renderings rather than consistent orthographic drawings. The printed 2.9718 m height is retained; uniform side scale implies about 2.72 m and front scale about 3.58 m. Horizontal tail elevation follows the side/cabin relationships rather than the raised front-view projection. No reference was stretched to conceal residuals.

Curved wing-root fillets, tips, fuselage cross-section, windscreen and nacelle transitions remain polygonal approximations; small aft-body, side-window and tailplane contour residuals remain. Rivet lines follow visible panel divisions, not a manufacturing fastener map.

Cockpit photo perspective/depth cannot exactly match the orthographic overlay. Pedestal curvature, climate controller, fine switch legends, seat contours and brake/gear mechanisms are simplified. No suitable freely licensed exact G58 cockpit photograph was verified for redistribution; manufacturer/Garmin imagery remains local study only. CC BY-SA exterior imagery also remains unshipped.

Displays show TAS, geometric world elevation, true heading and normalized simulated engine shaft RPM scaled to 2700. IAS/pressure altitude, magnetic errors, propeller governing, manifold pressure, thermal/oil/fuel/electrical systems, navigation and propeller sync are not simulated. Unsupported indications are blank or INOP; standby-speed calibration is approximate.

Both throttle handles follow the shared pilot power input; independent engine-state channels can drive different tachometer values but separate cockpit throttle interaction is not yet provided. Propeller/mixture levers, trim and most switches remain static. Three gear lamps share one simulated gear sensor and the gear doors use simplified linked motion; current pilot flap input selects only up/down.

controlReview.checks: Imported GLB control-point movement tested at positive and negative commands; all 20 aircraft pass. Cockpit pairs and all ten airplane exterior pairs visually inspected. Roll, pitch, rudder and declared pedal directions corrected; ailerons and full flap deployment corrected.
limitations: Checks cover existing bindings; Cherokee and Caravan pedal geometry is static.
Full control travel and flight response remain approximations unless independently dimensioned in the model reference notes.
This audit verifies movement; it does not upgrade legacy helicopter avionics or remove previously documented geometry limitations.
